Questions

How do I take it?
Two softgels with your first meal, every morning. That is 500 mg of Urolithin A, the dose studied in human trials. The trials measured changes from week four onward.
Will I feel anything?
Not the way you feel caffeine. Urolithin A works at the level of your cells, over weeks. The trials measured it as strength at 16 weeks and endurance at four months, so give it a full cycle before you judge it.
Why not just eat pomegranates?
Only about one in three people have the gut bacteria that turn pomegranate into Urolithin A, and even they can't eat their way to 500 mg. Myvo One delivers the finished molecule, so your gut stops being the bottleneck.
How is this different from cheaper Urolithin A online?
Independent testing found most Urolithin A sold online doesn't contain the dose on its label. Myvo publishes a third-party report for every batch, showing purity and dose per softgel, before anything ships.
How is every batch tested?
Before a batch ships, an independent NABL-accredited lab in India measures Urolithin A purity (HPLC), dose per softgel, heavy metals (ICP-MS), microbes and residual solvents. If a batch fails, it doesn't ship. The QR on your carton opens that batch's report.
When can I buy it?
Myvo One isn't on sale yet. Batch 001 goes on sale once it has cleared independent testing. Everyone on the waitlist hears first, and the first 100 get the founding price, locked for life.
